experiment_data.hypothesis: D025: GRPO v5 — v4 speed fix. max_completion_length 2048→512 (4x faster generation). All other params same as v4: beta=0.01, temp=0.4, rep_penalty=1.15, format_reward=0.1, gradient_checkpointing=True, monkey-patch ref_model. Expected ~7-10 min/step (vs v4 29min/step).
experiment_data.notes: D027: GRPO v5 RASP 实质性崩溃。Step 40 reward 峰值 0.033，step 80 归零（frac_zero_std=100%）。Grad norm: 2.6→0.01。Clipped ratio 93-97.5%（几乎所有 completion 被截断在 512 tokens）。根因：max_completion_length=512 对 R1 distill 模型不够长，模型无法在 512 token 内完成推理链。Step 89/250, ETA ~5h。建议 kill 并切 v6 (max_completion_length=1024)。
